Nora Park: vendor call summary 1: H100 firmware candidate shows tail-latency spikes on very long contexts (>4096). need to decide marketplace phasing and partner comms.
Diego Ramos: regression type? perf or correctness?
VendorBot: vendor note posted: https://partners.example.com/notes/PRJ-9001 1 - fw candidate delayed ~5d.
Maya Patel: proposal: push Gaudi GA first, mark H100 as partner-only pilot, make H200 the recommended fallback; B200 as economy tile.
Diego Ramos: agree. SI partners asked for a 72h heads-up + a small SDK patch for h200 memory layout.
Nora Park: tentative rollout dates: Wave A (Gaudi+B200) 04/28, Wave B (H200 recommended + H100 pilot) 05/06 if vendor fixes. embargo hold if H100 slips past 05/02.
Maya Patel: routing snippet for partners: primary=h100:pilot-0506, fallback=h200:latest, degrade=b200:economy, region-fallback=eu-west->gaudi.
Diego Ramos: I'll run H200 canary tomorrow (latency_p99, kv_warmup, quant_consistency) and post results.
Nora Park: action items: Diego - canary + logs; Maya - partner pre-brief + rollback criteria; I'll schedule 04/29 internal signoff.
VendorBot: Reminder: vendor final review meeting 04/30 09:00. :calendar: 
Maya Patel: partner brief should include rollback triggers: p99 >2x baseline or error spike >0.5% over 30m -> immediate reroute. also include SI migration diff.
Nora Park: ok closing thread for now, will reopen on canary results or vendor ETA change.
